hypotheses.title: Informed Options Flow: Put-Call Volume Ratio Anomaly
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Following Pan & Poteshman (2006), sophisticated options market participants accumulate call contracts ahead of favorable news and buy puts ahead of unfavorable news. Stocks with low put-to-call volume ratios (pcr_vol_all) reflect informed institutional call accumulation. Quadratic power scaling concentrates capital into the highest call-conviction names, while an orthogonal 15% 3-day reversal overlay provides execution timing with low turnover and zero correlation to pure volatility alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high put-to-call volume ratios reflect retail panic rather than informed directional flow.

candidates.rationale: Informed options flow: low put/call volume ratio power-scaled with 15% 3-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Options Breakeven Asymmetry: Implied Upside vs Downside Drift
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the cross-sectional asymmetry between 120-day call option breakeven prices (call_breakeven_120) and put option breakeven prices (put_breakeven_120) relative to current stock price. When the options market demands a wider breakeven premium on calls than puts, it prices in positive right-tail distribution asymmetry, predicting positive medium-term stock returns. Dimensionless and free of unit mismatch.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if option market breakevens reflect mispriced lottery tickets rather than directional drift.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-ranked options breakeven asymmetry (upside minus downside breakeven over close)

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Acceleration & Cash Flow Efficiency
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms exhibiting both accelerating multi-factor fundamental momentum (multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative) and superior operational cash flow profitability (cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) capture fundamental corporate health improvements before full market incorporation. Both fields have 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000, creating dense, low-turnover, non-decaying alpha.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if fundamental acceleration is already fully priced in by equity analysts.

candidates.rationale: Power-scaled multi-factor acceleration plus cash flow efficiency with 15% reversal
